meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.
